title: Knit - Lead Product Manager
description:
A little about us…

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.

You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.

Outcomes

Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.

  • Customer adoption of shipped work: Usage and adoption rates of new and materially updated capabilities within our target ICP.

  • Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

The hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

  1. Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent. You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.

  2. System design session with our engineering team. No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.

  3. Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in Europe with quarterly trips to London.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
YGO.ai is a VC-funded AI tourism platform. We are hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to own the security of our cloud platform, the APIs our enterprise clients run on and the company itself.


🛡️ About this role. The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.

The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.

We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

  • Application security. Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

  • Detection and response. Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

  • Cloud and platform hardening. Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

  • The security of our APIs. Authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, token scoping and lifecycle, abuse prevention, enterprise SSO and the audit trail our clients and our own accountability depend on

  • The security of our AI systems. Prompt injection, tool and agent permissions, our MCP server, retrieval and data ingestion. The data-residency rules we are held to contractually

  • Identity and company security. SSO, MFA and privileged access for employees, onboarding and offboarding, access reviews, MDM, endpoint security and SaaS access. The practical IT security a company our size needs done, not discussed

  • Secure design across the pods. Threat modelling and design review that enables engineers rather than gatekeeping them and raises the standard of what they ship

  • The security function itself. Set the priorities and the roadmap from actual risk, not security theatre. Decide what we build, buy, automate or leave for later. Grow the team and hire into it, represent security to enterprise clients and carry our SOC 2 programme on Drata. Compliance is part of the job and it is not the centre of it

🚢 What you'll secure

  • An AI search and recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration, SSO, client security reviews, GDS integrations

  • A content enrichment API sold as SaaS: high scale, public facing, data and AI heavy

  • The platform underneath: a client console with organisations, projects and API tokens, supplier and business-client integrations, data ingestion, an MCP server, and several LLM providers behind a single internal library

📚 Our stack

  • Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Redis Asynq queue

  • Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, Cloudflare in front

  • Observability: Jaeger tracing, BetterStack for logging, alerting and on-call

  • Compliance: Drata, SOC 2 in progress

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, used across the whole team

✅ You must have

  • 5+ years of hands-on security work spanning more than one discipline. Not five years of engineering with some security in it. This role sets the standard for the company, so it needs someone who has seen enough to have judgement rather than opinions

  • Application security depth. You know how modern web applications and APIs are attacked. You can validate an issue yourself through code review or a targeted penetration test and work with the engineer on the fix

  • A strong grasp of authentication and authorization. OAuth and OIDC, sessions, token handling, access control and the failure modes behind most API breaches

  • Cloud security fundamentals, properly. Identity, network, workload and pipeline security on a modern cloud platform, applied to production systems you were responsible for

  • Defensive experience alongside the offensive. You have investigated real incidents. You have built or improved the detection and alerting that catches them

  • Threat modelling and secure architecture for cloud, container and API systems

  • An engineering background. You are comfortable in a codebase, you can review what our engineers and our AI tools produce and you can build what you need yourself. Our backend is Go. Prior Go experience is a plus and not a requirement

  • Comfort in resource-constrained environments. Startups, small security teams or consultancies taught you to prioritize on risk, business impact and available resources and to execute yourself

  • The appetite to build a team. You want to grow this function and eventually lead it. Prior leadership experience is a plus and not a requirement. We would rather have depth and develop the leadership than the reverse

  • Working proficiency with Claude Code. Share specific examples

  • Judgement about pace. You secure a company that ships daily without becoming the reason it stops. Guardrails over gates

  • Experience of SOC 2, ISO 27001 or demanding enterprise security reviews

  • Excellent spoken and written English. You will talk to auditors, client security teams and our own engineers, often in the same week

  • ⚠️ European or African time zones (±3 hours from CET)

  • Available full-time (40 hours per week)

🌟 Nice to have

  • AI and LLM security: prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, model security, retrieval pipelines. Very few security roles let you both use AI as your main tool and secure it as your subject. This one does

  • Early security hire experience. You have been the first or one of the first security hires at a startup or scale-up

  • Experience leading or mentoring security engineers

  • Go

  • Security tooling or automation you built yourself

  • MDM, endpoint protection and identity provider administration (Google Workspace or similar)

  • Compliance automation tooling (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe or similar)

  • Security certifications. Valued as a signal, never required

  • GDPR depth. Travel or GDS exposure

  • German

❤️ You are a great fit if you

  • See security as an engineering discipline. You ship fixes and guardrails, not slide decks

  • Can explain a vulnerability to an engineer and its business risk to a client's security lead in the same afternoon

  • Have done offensive work as a penetration tester or consultant and wanted broader ownership than producing reports

  • Want to build something and own it, rather than advise on someone else's

  • Are comfortable challenging unnecessary security bureaucracy and genuinely risky engineering decisions alike

  • Get frustrated when a security fix takes weeks instead of days

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges. Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. 4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our design team. You'll take features end to end, from research and flows through to the finished interface, for an analytics platform that mobile gaming studios use every day to decide where their marketing money goes. You'll also own our design system: the components, patterns and documentation that everything else is built from. This is a broad role. You'll do research, interaction design, visual design and system work, and you'll do it in a small team where your decisions ship.

At justtrack, we build a SaaS business that provides app and game publishers with an attractive toolset to manage their entire global growth marketing process. Starting from managing, analyzing, and automating marketing processes, justtrack enables gathering deep mobile product insights. As part of the Applike Group (financially backed by media powerhouse Bertelsmann), justtrack has access to industry experts and funding with a long-term growth mindset.

What you will do:

  • Work AI-First: Use AI tools as a standard part of your design process, research synthesis, copy, design generation and iteration, with the judgement to know where the output needs your correction.

  • Own Features End to End: Take features from problem statement through research, flows and interface to shipped result, without handing off between layers.

  • Own the Design System: Build, document, and evolve our design system, components, variants, states, tokens, and decide how it changes as the product grows.

  • Design for Data Density: Design charts and data-heavy screens where information hierarchy and readability matter more than decoration.

  • Design AI-Assisted Surfaces: Shape how our AI features present their output, transparency, confidence, review steps, and what happens when the model gets it wrong.

  • Work Closely with Engineering: Specify components so frontend can build them directly, and review the built result against the design.

  • Talk to Users: Run research and usability tests with gaming studios and internal stakeholders, and turn what you learn into design decisions.

Who you are:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years in product design or a comparable end-to-end design role, ideally on a complex SaaS product.

  • Background: A degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • AI Fluency: You already work with AI tools day to day and have a clear view of where they help and where they don't.

  • End-to-End Craft: You're strong across the whole range: research, flows, interaction and visual design, rather than deep in one and dependent on others for the rest.

  • Design System Expertise: You've built and maintained a design system in production, including documentation and the governance decisions that keep it coherent.

  • Tools: Expert in Figma. It's where our final designs live, and where our design system is built and maintained.

  • Portfolio: You have a strong portfolio showing end-to-end work, the problem, your decisions, the finished interface, and what it changed.

  • Collaboration: You work well with product owners and engineers, articulate your rationale clearly, and can hold a position without stalling the work.

  • Optional: Experience designing for analytics, data visualization, or another data-dense environment.

  • Optional: Familiarity with front-end frameworks (e.g. React) and component development tools (e.g. Storybook).

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to justtrack: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

The Interview Process:

  • 1st: Interview with TA

  • 2nd: Interview with the Lead UX/UI Designer

  • 3rd: On-site day in our Hamburg office, a case study, followed by an interview with the design team and our Director of Product

  • 4th: Team fit call with our Managing Director

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

Mandatory:

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

The role is fundamentally about building a strong analytical foundation: making it easier for teams to move from question to insight quickly, while maintaining high standards around data quality, scalability, and maintainability.

title: Technical Account Manager - German Speaking
description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates located in Germany.

⚡ The Day-to-Day

  • Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set.

  • Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth.

  • Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency.

  • Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability.

  • Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams.

  • Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health.

💪 Your Superpowers

  • Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Bring 5+ years of SaaS technical troubleshooting and 2+ years of enterprise/large account management experience.

  • Integration & Auth Mastery: Hold a solid foundation in back-end practices, RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and front-end essentials like JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.

  • Data & Middleware Savvy: Possess hands-on skills in at least two key areas: iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier), SQL queries, or data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI).

  • Executive Translator: Master the art of taking complex, highly technical concepts and translating them into simple, high-value business conversations for executive decision-makers.

  • Global Flexibility & Travel: Ready to support EMEA regional time zones and comfortable traveling internationally up to 25% of the time.

  • Project Management Mindset: Bring proactive ownership, analytical decision-making, and experience forecasting product release impacts or advising on AI/automation integrations.

  • German language proficiency is required; however, English is the primary language used for day-to-day communication and collaboration.

🌟 Bonus Points

  • Cloud Certified: Possess an active AWS Product Certification.

  • Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries.

  • Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. title: Senior Engineering Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Warum diese Rolle?

Verwaltungen stecken im Investitionsstau. Du bist unser Turbo.
Spare Behörden bis zu 90 % Zeit bei der Ausschreibungserstellung – und erlebe täglich, wie Deine Arbeit echten Impact entfaltet. Mit unserer KI-SaaS-Lösung automatisierst Du mit GovRadar Ausschreibungen in Minuten statt Wochen und setzt so jährlich 500 Mrd. € öffentliche Mittel frei – ob Laptops für Schulen, moderne Ausrüstung für Feuerwehren oder kommunale Ladesäulen. Du machst Politik für Bürger:innen spürbar.
GovRadar: Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.
Sei dabei, wenn wir gemeinsam den digitalen Wandel im öffentlichen Sektor gestalten.


Deine Mission

Bei GovRadar ist AI First weit mehr als ein technologischer Ansatz, es ist die Grundlage dafür, wie wir denken, entscheiden und arbeiten. Du treibst diese Transformation in deinem Team maßgeblich voran und gestaltest eine Arbeitsweise, in der das Zusammenspiel von Mensch und KI Zusammenarbeit, Produktentwicklung, Prozesse und Architektur von Grund auf neu definiert.

  • Du führst dein Team von 5 Engineers fachlich und disziplinarisch, gibst regelmäßiges Feedback und förderst die individuelle Weiterentwicklung jedes einzelnen Teammitglieds.
  • Du treibst den kulturellen Wandel hin zu KI-gestützter Entwicklung aktiv voran. Unser Ziel ist, dass der überwiegende Teil des produktiven Codes im Team durch KI-Agenten unter menschlicher Anweisung entsteht.
  • Du bist selbst hands-on dabei – du entwickelst aktiv mit und treibst Architekturentscheidungen und komplexe technische Probleme voran und schaffst damit direkten Mehrwert am Produkt. Deine Arbeitsweise ist value-driven, du priorisierst konsequent nach dem, was für Nutzer:innen und Geschäft wirklich zählt
  • Du verantwortest verlässliche Lieferung, Systemstabilität und Verfügbarkeit deines Verantwortungsbereichs und sorgst für den gezielten Abbau technischer Schulden.
  • Die gezielte Weiterbildung jedes einzelnen Teammitglieds ist dir enorm wichtig, bei uns ist das kein Nice-to-have, sondern fester Bestandteil unserer Ziele.
  • Du entwickelst dein Team aktiv und zukunftsorientiert weiter, technisch wie organisatorisch, und machst es so fit für ein sich schnell änderndes Umfeld.
  • Du führst dein Team gemeinsam mit der Produktmanagerin als Doppelspitze.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den anderen Engineering Managern, dem Senior Software Architekten und dem Head of Development zusammen.
  • Du treibst Recruiting und Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder aktiv mit voran.


Dein Profil

Must have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen und fachlichen Führung eines Engineering-Teams
  • Freude daran, nah am Team und am Code zu bleiben und Führung direkt und persönlich zu leben
  • Technisches Verständnis auf Architektur-Ebene und die Fähigkeit, dort wo nötig fachlich mit anzupacken und echten wertschöpfenden Beitrag zu leisten
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit unserem Tech-Stack: TypeScript und Vue3 im Frontend, Python im Backend
  • Eine klare Haltung zu AI First: Für dich ist manuelles Coding nicht mehr der Normalfall. Du kannst KI-Agenten nicht nur nutzen, sondern gezielt steuern, orchestrieren und kontrollieren. Dein Ziel ist ein Team, in dem KI den Großteil des Codes erzeugt, während Menschen Richtung, Architektur und Qualitätsmaßstäbe verantworten.
  • Erfahrung mit moderner Cloud- und Container-Infrastruktur, CI/CD und einer "You build it, you run it"-Kultur
  • Ausgeprägte People- und Culture-Skills: Empathie, aktives Zuhören, Konfliktfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, nachhaltiges Vertrauen aufzubauen
  • Erfahrung mit situativer Führung, bei der du deinen Stil an Reifegrad und Situation anpasst
  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein im Sinne von Ownership. Du stehst zu dem, was dein Team liefert.
  • Veränderungswillen und echten Pioniergeist: Du hinterfragst Bestehendes, probierst mutig Neues aus und kannst andere für Veränderung gewinnen.
  • Deutsch als Muttersprache oder C2-Niveau
Nice to have
  • Erfahrung im öffentlichen Sektor oder mit B2G-Produkten
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung von Engineering-Organisationen (Startup/Scale-up)


Was dich erwartet

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist:

  • Du gestaltest den AI-First-Kulturwandel aktiv mit – Dein Ziel: der Großteil des Codes entsteht durch KI-Agenten unter menschlicher Steuerung
  • Du bleibst hands-on bei Architekturentscheidungen und komplexen technischen Problemen und schaffst direkten Produkt-Impact
  • Du führst Dein Team als Doppelspitze mit der Produktmanagerin und arbeitest eng mit Senior Software Architekt und Head of Development zusammen
  • Du übernimmst volle Verantwortung – fachlich, disziplinarisch und für Lieferung, Stabilität und technische Exzellenz deines Bereichs
Was wir sonst noch bieten:
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact – Hebe öffentliche Mittel frei und mach Verwaltungen handlungsfähig.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten – Fully Remote + EU-Workation.
  • Weiterentwicklung – Budget für Tools, Weiterbildungen & Reisen plus Mentoring.
  • Ownership – Übernimm sofort Verantwortung, bring eigene Ideen ein und setze sie um.
  • Team & Kultur – Interdisziplinär, transparent, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer Prise Humor.
  • Gesundheit & Ausgleich – Mit Wellpass hast du Zugang zu zahlreichen Sport- und Wellnessangeboten für deinen Ausgleich im Alltag
Unsere Werte
⭐️ Qualität als Standard
⭐️ Begeisterung, die ansteckt
⭐️ Lösungsorientierung statt Hürden
⭐️ Ehrlichkeit & Integrität
⭐️ Grenzen sprengen - technologisch & mental


Interesse geweckt?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!

Auch wenn Dein Lebenslauf nicht zu 100 % passt – wenn Du Dich angesprochen fühlst, sprich mit uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deinen Wechsel – von der Verwaltung in die Wirkung.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE): United Kingdom
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Remote / 20% Travel

 

About forgd

forgd is the consultancy partnering exclusively with Anthropic to help enterprises build AI-native businesses. We start with engineering — helping organizations move from individual developers using Claude Code to entire teams shipping together with AI-native workflows — and expand into agentic solution delivery and broader business transformation.

Our conviction is that engineers are uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. The strongest mental model for designing, deploying, and governing AI agents in production lives in software engineering. The teams that change how their organization builds software are the same teams equipped to shepherd the rest of the business into this new world.

We embed and co-build with customer teams. Cycles are short, delivery is iterative and accountable to clear outcome goals.

 

About the Role

As an FDE, you embed with enterprise customers and own the technical work across the full customer journey — initial demos, short proof-of-value engagements, and multi-week implementations. The work moves customers from interesting prototypes to production capability.

Most engagements start in engineering. You'll work with customer engineering teams adopting Claude Code and redesigning their SDLC — code review, requirements, testing, documentation, and governance. From there, the work expands: co-building agentic applications and modernizing legacy systems on the Claude developer platform, and partnering with business stakeholders to deploy agents into core operations like sales, customer service, and finance.

You're the expert in the room on how engineers work with Claude Code, what an agentic application looks like in production, and what has to change in an organization to sustain either. You build prototypes, ship code, run workshops, write specs, and make the calls that move customers from demos to deployment.

Collaborate directly with Anthropic on customer engagements — joint working sessions, early access to product changes, and a direct line to their product and engineering teams.

 

Responsibilities

Enable

  • Lead Claude Code Labs and customer workshops

  • Take customer teams from beginner to power user across Claude Code, Claude for Work, Cowork, and the developer platform

  • Codify deployment patterns and feed them back to forgd's methodology and Anthropic's product teams

Transform

  • Lead discovery into customer environments — engineering toolchains and workflows, business operations, and organizational dynamics — and turn that into clear technical plans

  • Advise on how AI-native development changes existing engineering practices: issue management, branching, testing, code review, and security

  • Guide adoption programs that scale Claude across engineering organizations and into business teams

Build

  • Scope engagements: assumptions, risks, milestones, and dependencies

  • Embed with customer teams to co-build agentic applications on the Claude developer platform

  • Build technical artifacts — evaluation frameworks, MCP servers, sub-agents, and deployment configurations — tailored to the customer's stack

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers move from proof-of-value to production

  • Engineering teams measurably change how they ship software

  • Customers become references

  • Accounts expand on the strength of the work

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • 3–5 years in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Consultant — or in a hands-on engineering role as a Software Engineer or Product Engineer

  • Software development experience in a high-scale startup or enterprise environment; you know what it takes to write, ship, and operate production code

  • Production experience with LLMs — prompt engineering, agent design, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Power user of Claude Code or equivalent AI coding assistants; you live in AI-native development yourself

  • Familiarity with enterprise development toolchains, CI/CD, and modern SDLC practices, and cloud-native deployment on AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Communication skills that work across the room — individual contributors, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders

  • High agency and comfort with ambiguity; you operate autonomously in customer environments

Nice to Have

  • Background in professional services or consulting

  • Track record leading developer productivity or developer experience at scale

  • Vertical experience in financial services, healthcare, or other regulated industries

  • Experience driving organizational change

What We Offer

  • Work at the frontier: Direct partnership with Anthropic — joint engagements, early access to product changes, and working sessions with their Applied AI team

  • Founding team: You shape how we work and grow as we scale

  • Remote: Fully remote across North American and European time zones

  • Compensation and benefits: Competitive salary, equity, and full benefits

How to Apply

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Research shows people from underrepresented groups often hesitate unless they meet every requirement, and we don't want you to exclude yourself prematurely. If you're excited about AI-native engineering and want to help enterprises change how they build software, we'd love to hear from you.

In dieser Position verbindest du fundierte technische Fähigkeiten mit ausgeprägtem Produktdenken. Du entwickelst mithilfe von KI Tools und Funktionen, die echten Mehrwert für unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie für unser Unternehmen schaffen. Dabei konkretisierst du Anforderungen, definierst technische Lösungsansätze und setzt Funktionen sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend um. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Einsatz von Programmierassistenten, sondern um die Entwicklung konkreter KI-Lösungen für reale Herausforderungen unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer.   • Datenmodellierung und skalierbare Systeme: Du entwickelst solide Datenmodelle und skalierbare Architekturen, die eine zuverlässige Grundlage für unsere Produkte bilden. Dadurch lässt sich jedes neue Tool schneller entwickeln als das vorherige.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und Förderung der Nutzung: Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammen – von der Geschäftsleitung bis zu den operativen Teams –, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung neuer Tools und Funktionen voranzutreiben. Technische Konzepte vermittelst du verständlich und schaffst organisationsweit Akzeptanz für deine Lösungen.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du holst frühzeitig Feedback ein, entwickelst Lösungen in kurzen Zyklen weiter und verbesserst deine Arbeit kontinuierlich.   • Beruflicher Hintergrund im E-Commerce, Großhandel oder im Umfeld von B2B-Plattformen.

Dein Profil

  • Fünf bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, verbunden mit einem ausgeprägten Produktverständnis.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript und modernen React-Anwendungen. Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Node.js, Express oder vergleichbaren Technologien, REST-APIs sowie PostgreSQL und praktische SQL-Kenntnisse. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung neuer Anwendungen mit unserem modernen Tech-Stack aus React 19, Vite, TypeScript und Bun. Gelegentlich arbeitest du außerdem an einer bestehenden JavaScript-Codebasis.
  • Vertrautheit mit modernen KI-/ML-Frameworks und agentischen KI-Systemen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenmodellierung und im Aufbau skalierbarer Systemarchitekturen.
  • Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten sicher und effektiv zu arbeiten.

  • Ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein im Engineering sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zuverlässiger und wartbarer Produkte und deren Absicherung durch geeignete Tests.
  • Starkes Produktverständnis: Du verstehst sowohl die geschäftlichen Prozesse als auch die Perspektive der Nutzerinnen und Nutzer – nicht nur den Code.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen und darin, die erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung der entwickelten Lösungen voranzutreiben.
  • Proaktive Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Selbstständigkeit und Initiative in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Waniwani

Waniwani builds the infrastructure that distributes insurance and banking products through AI assistants. We raised an $8M seed led by Seedcamp and work with large European banks and insurers. Each enterprise deal has to be scoped, architected, and deployed into a regulated environment. This role owns the layer between a signed deal and a live deployment.

The role

  • Customer workshops, discovery, and requirements (35%). Run technical discovery and workshops with each client, and translate their needs into clear, buildable product requirements for our sales, ops, and engineering teams. Flag what we need to build to support a given setup, such as client self-hosting.

  • Solution architecture and documentation (35%). Design the end-to-end MCP flow and integration architecture for each client, including hosted versus on-premise scenarios, and produce the technical documentation enterprise clients require (BPI France alone is roughly 50 docs).

  • Procurement, security, and delivery oversight (30%). Use our existing compliance library (SOC 2 program, DPAs, prior questionnaire answers) to complete security questionnaires, handle security committees and data-residency questions, and drive procurement to completion. Oversee the MCP deployment itself, which our freelancer network implements.

Across all three, you build the reusable kit that makes this repeatable: scoping templates, architecture patterns, and a procurement answer library.

Objectives

  • 90 days: own scoping and procurement response for active deals, with the reusable kit used on at least one live deal end to end.

  • 6 months: run the full signed-to-live pipeline, including architecture decisions and procurement ownership, without founders in the critical path.

  • 12 months: a repeatable delivery process with patterns reused across clients, and a case for the first hire under this role.

Requirements

  • You are technically credible: you read code, reason fluently about integrations and the MCP and agent stack, and can scope and oversee a deployment. This is not a hands-on production-coding role; implementation is handled by our freelancer network.

  • You are comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise clients.

  • You can drive a security questionnaire or procurement process to completion from existing documentation.

  • You have worked in or near regulated industries (finance, insurance) and understand compliance and data residency requirements.

  • You work well in ambiguity across sales, ops, and engineering, and ramp into new domains quickly.

  • You have an interest in the MCP and agent stack.

  • You are open to traveling from time to time across Europe and the US to meet clients.

What this role is not

  • A backend engineering role. You will work with clients most of the week.

  • A pure pre-sales role. You own architecture, requirements, and delivery oversight, not only the pitch.

  • A slideware role. You need real technical depth, even though you are not writing production code day to day.

Practicalities

  • Remote-first, based in Europe. Expect travel roughly once a month, primarily Paris, London, and Madrid, with US travel around the 6-month mark. Being able to come to Paris occasionally is a plus but not required.

  • First hire in this function, working directly with the founders and the engineering team.

Process

  • Intro call with our talent partner.

  • 30-minute conversation with Max, our CTO.

  • Work sample based on a real client scenario (live session): scope the flow, draft the architecture, and handle a mock procurement Q&A.

  • Discussions with Robin, our CEO, Luiza, and members of the tech team.

  • Reference checks.

title: Accounting Solutions Consultant
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounting Solutions Consultant to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles

  • Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows

  • Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders

  • Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

  • Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

Tier A: $100,000 – $150,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team.

You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server.

Concretely, you will:

Build safety into the platform

  • Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early.
  • Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use.
  • Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it.

Think security first

  • Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment.
  • Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through.
  • Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan.

Work as one with Community Management

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

  • Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

  • Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

  • Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

  • Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

  • Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

  • Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

  • Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

  • Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

  • Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

  • Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

  • Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

  • Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

  • Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

  • Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

  • Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

  • Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

  • Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

  • Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

  • Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

  • Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

  • Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

  • A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

  • Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

  • The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

  • A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

  • Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

  • Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

  • Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

  • Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

  • An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

  • A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

  • a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

  • a delivery or project management position;

  • a Product Manager role;

title: Creator Success Representative
description:
Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

As Fanvue scales, we need to protect and grow revenue across our mid-to-long-tail creator base without relying on 1:1 CSM ratios. The Pooled CSM model is how we do that: one person owning a large book of creators through data-driven playbooks, automated workflows, and targeted interventions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Pooled Creator Success Manager to own retention and revenue outcomes across a portfolio of 500+ creators in a 1:many, tech-touch model.

This is not a traditional CSM seat. You will not have a handful of named accounts and weekly check-ins. Instead, you will build and run scalable playbooks, monitor risk and contraction signals across a large cohort, and intervene where the data tells you to. Think CS operations meets account management.

You will report to Thea and work closely with the wider Creator Success team.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Own a pooled book of 500+ creators with full accountability for gross revenue retention

  • Build, maintain, and iterate playbooks that drive retention, reduce contraction, and surface expansion opportunities at scale

  • Monitor creator health signals (engagement drops, earnings decline, support ticket spikes) and run targeted interventions before churn materialises

  • Run a weekly cadence: risk alerts, contraction monitoring, playbook execution reviews

  • Design and automate lifecycle touchpoints (onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, feature adoption nudges) through CS platform workflows

  • Support the broader CS team by providing pooled coverage as more creators move out of dedicated 1:1 management

  • Provide reactive support to creators in the pooled segment when risks, problems, or support needs arise

  • Partner with Product, Support, Moderation, and Growth to close feedback loops and improve creator outcomes

  • Track and report on cohort-level retention, contraction, and engagement metrics

👀 Who You Are

  • Experienced in Customer Success, Account Management, or CS Operations, ideally in a tech-touch or SMB/scale segment

  • Hands-on experience with a CS platform (health scoring, playbook automation, lifecycle workflows)

  • Comfortable building playbooks, automations, and health scores from scratch, not just running someone else's

  • Data-literate: you can pull insights from dashboards, spot trends in cohort data, and translate them into actions

  • Strong written communicator who can craft clear, concise creator-facing messaging at scale

  • Comfortable managing a large book through systems and signals rather than personal relationships

  • Self-directed and structured, you set your own cadence and hold yourself accountable

  • Familiar with the creator economy, subscription platforms, or marketplace models (a plus, not a must)

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You like building systems more than managing relationships one by one

  • You get energy from finding patterns in data and acting on them before anyone asks

  • You want ownership of a segment, not just a task list

  • You are motivated by retention metrics and commercial outcomes

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You prefer deep 1:1 relationships over scaled models

  • You need someone else to build your workflows and tell you what to automate

  • You are uncomfortable with ambiguity or building processes from zero

  • You wait for problems to surface rather than hunting for them

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • AI-native engineering: we are not bolting AI on. It is core to our product and how we build

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the problems you solve today define the platform for years

  • Fully remote with unlimited PTO, flexible working hours, a London office and WeWork access when you want it

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Senior EV Field Service Engineer - UK
description:
Your mission

Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow!

As an EV Field Service Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products.

This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future.

Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel, with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites.

Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service

Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics

  • Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults.
  • Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems.
  • Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products.
  • Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime.

Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting

  • Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements.
  • Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks.
  • Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders.
  • Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements.
  • Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation.
  • Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations.

Specialised Tool Expertise

  • Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools.
  • Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance.
Product Improvement & Data Management

Quality Issue Reporting

  • Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement.

Database Management

  • Maintain accurate customer, service, and issue records in internal systems.

Data Processing Enhancement

  • Support improvements to internal data-processing methods and platforms to strengthen performance evaluation and fault detection.


Your profile

  • Hands-on experience in an electrotechnical or electrical engineering field, with strong practical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A genuine interest in green technology and EV charging infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking and experience using command-line tools to diagnose network issues.
  • Experience with OCPP and Modbus-TCP communication protocols is highly desirable.
  • Ability to interpret electrical single-line diagrams to diagnose system performance and faults.
  • Technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or professional statistical-analysis software; Linux knowledge is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to support non-technical customers in troubleshooting situations.
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above is required. Additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Must be based in the United Kingdom and able to travel extensively across the country, with occasional international travel for training or troubleshooting.
  • Existing right to work in the UK is required; visa sponsorship or relocation may be considered for exceptional candidates.

title: Football Tracking Technician (North)
description:
Location: We are currently hiring across key Northern regions and North East coastal hubs. Ideal candidates will be within easy commuting distance of partner EPL and EFL stadiums across these target areas.

Contract Type: Casual hourly contract – Setup Day & Match Day
Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour. Rates vary depending on role

 

Role Overview:

As a Football Tracking Technician, you will work on-site at football stadiums across your region, playing a vital role in the delivery of Hawk-Eye’s tracking and officiating technologies for Premier League, EFL, and UEFA fixtures.

You will be responsible for the setup, calibration, and optimisation of services including Goal Line Technology (GLT) and Electronic Performance & Tracking Systems (EPTS). This includes connecting and configuring PCs and hardware within stadium fibre-optic networks, optimising camera alignments, troubleshooting technical issues in real time, and coordinating closely with remote operations centres, on-site technical leads, and replay operators to ensure seamless match delivery.

Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a flexible routine. Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on weekends with occasional midweek commitments for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with strong availability to cover these key operational windows.

 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Stadium Setup: Rigging Hawk-Eye technology at the stadium. Please note: This involves physically demanding work, including running heavy cables, rigging cameras, and working at height.

  • System Calibration: Conducting pre-match setup, hardware checks, and technical calibration of tracking systems in accordance with standard operational procedures.

  • Live Match Monitoring: Actively monitoring hardware and software performance during live matches to instantly troubleshoot, resolve, and report technical errors.

  • Stakeholder Management: Liaising professionally with stadium staff, match officials, and host broadcasters on-site, serving as a trusted brand ambassador for Hawk-Eye

 

Why Is This The Right Job For You?

We’re looking for individuals who are reliable, professional, and passionate about football. This position is perfect for you if you possess:

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

  • A passion for innovation

  • A willingness to learn

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment

  • Flexible schedule with primary weekend availability

  • An interest in the sport of Football

 

Skills and Requirements

Essential Criteria and Skills

  • Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of computer hardware, networking, and fibre-optic connectivity, with a quick aptitude for learning in-house technology and software.

  • Availability & Flexibility: : Strong schedule flexibility, with primary availability focused on weekends and occasional midweek evening matchdays/training sessions in alignment with the football calendar

  • Professionalism: High level of professionalism and a calm, solutions-focused attitude when working in highly visible, client-facing scenarios.

  • Mobility: A full UK driving license

  • Passion: Strong football knowledge and a genuine interest in the sport.

 

Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience:

  • Broadcast and Live events experience

  • Video routing Knowledge

  • Experience with Audio Over IP devices

 

What Difficulties Might I Face?

Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored.

Working Hours: Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles right to the end.

High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed to millions worldwide will bring high levels of pressure

As You Progress:

You may also have the chance to:

  • Opportunities for full-time employment

  • Increase your skillset and be more involved within our team

  • Contribute to improvements in VAR workflows and cutting-edge tech development

We’ll support you every step of the way, but these are roles where focus, resilience, and professionalism are a must.

 

Team Culture

At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values:

  • We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence.

  • We are Owners: We take personal accountability for our work, our decisions, and our collective success. We celebrate our wins together and treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn, grow, and improve.

  • We are Inclusive: We believe our diversity makes us stronger. We cultivate a welcoming environment where unique perspectives are valued, all while being united by our shared love for sports and technology.
